headline: Sources: Broncos S Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) set to miss multiple weeks
summary: Safety Talanoa Hufanga, who has made several key plays for the Broncos defense in recent wins, is expected to miss multiple weeks with an ankle injury, sources told ESPN.

headline: Falcons QB Michael Penix on track to start vs. Bears if no setbacks, coach says
summary: Falcons quarterback Michael Penix Jr. will start Sunday against the Bears despite a rib injury, as long as there are no setbacks during the week.

headline: Report: Lamar Jackson has a "realistic chance" to return Week 6
summary: On Monday, Ravens head coach Jesse Minter told reporters that quarterback Lamar Jackson was "definitely doing better" after missing Week 5 with an ankle injury.

headline: Ravens Designate WR Ja’Kobi Lane For Return; Latest On Lamar Jackson
summary: 12:56pm: The Ravens have officially opened Lane’s practice window, per Jeff Zrebiec of The Athletic. Outside linebacker Trey Hendrickson and center Cam Jurgens were also back at practice Wednesday, whereas Jackson was not present during media viewing, according to Jamison Hensley of ESPN. headline: Micah Parsons: I want to make sure all the small things are fixed before returning
summary: Parsons said he'd play if the Super Bowl was this week, but wants to be sure "everything is right."

headline: Andy Reid can join George Halas and Paul Brown as the only coaches with six 5-0 starts
summary: The Chiefs are 4-0, which means they're one win away from putting Andy Reid in some very elite historic company.
